issues.detail: As the catalog notes, PROTOCOL.md User Styles says a user style never overrides project instructions. A run that applies the Google format and records the conflict without blocking may be as defensible as one that blocks for resolution. Both assertions only forbid a silent override and a blanket rewrite or routine approval, so they hold under either reading.
issues.fix: Judge should accept either surfacing-and-blocking or explicitly applying the project instruction with a recorded, user-visible note; neither is a silent override.

The rule's first sentence ('Every exported function ... carries a docstring') and Documenter's ownership of docstrings still make the conflict reasonably material.
